summary: This is a routine Form 8-K filed by Strategy Inc updating its at-the-market (ATM) equity program sales and Bitcoin holdings. The filing discloses that during June 15-21, 2026, Strategy sold 2,714,839 shares of Class A common stock for net proceeds of $335.5 million; no preferred stock sales occurred. The total remaining ATM capacity across all securities (MSTR, STRF, STRC, STRK, STRD) aggregates to substantial amounts, including $21 billion for MSTR stock under a prior increase. Additionally, Strategy purchased 520 Bitcoin for $34.9 million at an average price of $67,068 per Bitcoin using ATM proceeds, bringing total Bitcoin holdings to 847,363 BTC acquired at an average cost of $75,651. This is a routine equity distribution and treasury update, not a special situation.
